summary: First full E2E run of Forts of Maharashtra. Backend: 27 pytest cases (public content, auth incl. cookies/origin guard/lockout/refresh, comments thread/like/report/spam/rate-limit/3-report auto-pending, favourites, itineraries, uploads to object storage, photo submission -> gallery publish, admin RBAC/stats/fort CRUD/story CRUD/users/settings) - 26 pass, 1 fail (brute-force lockout bypassed behind ingress). Frontend (Playwright, desktop + mobile): homepage hero/search/CTAs/stats/carousel/categories, directory (search, all 9 filters, alphabet, grid/list, pagination 12/12/10, clear all), fort detail /forts/raigad (all sections, mini-map, gallery lightbox credit/licence, favourite sign-in toast), comments (post question, reply, like toggle, report dialog, delete own, image comment -> pending -> admin approve), map (34 markers, type toggles, district toggle, search -> preview card w/ Open full profile + nearby, circuit polyline), planner (?add=, add/remove, circuit load, optimise, move up/down, save requires login, save when logged in, localStorage persistence), auth (register, login, wrong password error, logout, Google session cookie via mongo-created session), profile (bucket list, itineraries, submissions, name update), contribute with image upload -> admin approve -> /gallery Community Contributions with attribution, admin (overview charts, add/edit/delete fort, stories list, photo credit+licence enforcement, users role selects, settings save), non-admin /admin shows 'Admin access required', stories/category/detail, community page, about. All core flows work.

critical.issue: Brute-force lockout is bypassable/unreliable in deployment. Identifier = request.client.host + email, but client.host is the ingress pod IP which alternates (logs show 10.66.0.11 and 10.66.5.130 for the same client), so 5 failed attempts get split across identifiers and the 6th correct login returns 200 instead of 429 (reproduced 4/4 runs; passed once earlier by chance). Fix: key lockout by email only, or use first IP of X-Forwarded-For.

minor.issue: Deletes only the comment and its direct replies; grand-child replies (reply to a reply) are orphaned and then surface as root comments via thread().
Users can report their own comments; no check c.user_id != u.user_id.
Issues new access token without checking the user still exists / is not banned.
images[] paths are not validated against the caller's uploaded files (db.files user_id) - any storage path can be referenced.
like_count in response computed from stale read (c['like_count'] +/- 1) - can be off under concurrent likes (cosmetic).

ui_bugs.issue: Any momentarily-invalid JSON (a single typo while editing) WIPES the entire advanced JSON textarea. Cause: <JsonEditor key={adv?.gallery?.length} ...>; on parse error onChange(undefined) sets adv=undefined -> key changes -> component remounts with JSON.stringify(undefined) -> textarea empty. Reproduced: typed one char at end of 936-char JSON -> textarea length 0. Fix: use a stable key (e.g. a counter bumped only in addPhoto) and don't remount on invalid state.
Source is always rendered as <a href={source}>; for community photos source='Community submission' -> broken relative link. Only link when source starts with http.
Grammar: '1 of your posts are awaiting moderation' -> pluralise.

issues: Stray <TypeTag> ('HILL FORT') rendered alone at the very bottom of the article after the discussion - looks orphaned
Discussion section is max-w-4xl leaving large empty right column on desktop
Preview card is flush against the header (top edge clipped/touching) - add top margin
Filter panel is open by default and covers ~75% of the map; should start collapsed on mobile
Logo wraps to 2 lines and 'SIGN IN' button wraps to 2 lines - cramped; reduce sizes or hide button into menu
Circuit cards have uneven widths and the Satara card's content is vertically offset vs others
Site header stays un-dimmed above the modal overlay (z-index higher than overlay)

action_items: HIGH: Fix login lockout identifier (use email only or X-Forwarded-For first IP) so 5 failed attempts reliably lock the account
HIGH: Fix FortsAdmin JsonEditor remount (key={adv?.gallery?.length}) that wipes JSON on any typo
Delete comment should cascade to all descendants (or delete by thread root)
Disallow reporting own comment; check user/banned on /auth/refresh; validate submission image paths belong to user
Gallery lightbox: only render source as link if it is a URL
Design: remove stray TypeTag at end of fort detail, collapse map panel on mobile, fix mobile header wrapping, planner mobile overflow, map preview card top spacing
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1007 lines - split into routers (auth, forts, comments, admin, seed)
seed_data.py 850 lines (data) acceptable but could be JSON
Admin endpoints accept raw request.json() for forts/stories/photos/settings/circuits without Pydantic models (only minimal checks) - e.g. lat/lng float() on bad input raises 500
login lockout increments count forever and resets locked_until on every failure (sliding window) - fine but combined with per-proxy-IP identifier ineffective
seed_admin correctly creates admin only if missing and never resets password; bcrypt hashes start with $2b$; cookies httpOnly+secure+SameSite=None verified; CORS uses explicit origins from env

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested flows functional; 1 high admin editor bug + minor/design issues)

rca of the issue: Lockout: login() builds ident from request.client.host; uvicorn behind k8s ingress sees ingress pod IPs (10.66.0.11 / 10.66.5.130 alternating) -> failed-attempt counter split across 2 docs, count never reaches 5 for either. JSON editor: FortsAdmin passes key={adv?.gallery?.length}; invalid JSON -> onChange(undefined) -> adv undefined -> key 0->undefined -> remount -> useState(JSON.stringify(undefined)) -> empty textarea, user edits lost.
